post.description: 1–100 operations. Client-generated stable entity and operation UUIDs. Create uses baseRevision 0. Accepted retries return duplicate; conflicting retries retain conflict status. Unexpected storage failures return HTTP 500 and must be retried with the same operation IDs. Supply the generation from the change feed to reject a push after restore.

get.summary: Pull one page of changes and tombstones
get.description: Default 100, maximum 500 events per page. Advance cursor only after applying the entire page locally. Deleted entities carry deleted=true and value=null. Empty pages can still advance the cursor. A changed generation requires clearing accepted caches and replaying from cursor 0 before pushing preserved edits.
